description: This file defines a validator class for the 'Field' class in the OpenMRS project. It contains logic for verifying that instances of Field meet specific validation criteria, such as non-null and non-empty attributes, proper length restrictions, and handling null support cases.

classes.name: FieldValidator
classes.description: A validator class implementing Spring's Validator interface, designed to validate Field objects within the OpenMRS platform.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Determines whether the validator supports validating instances of the specified class, returning true if the class is assignable from Field.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation on the given Field object, checking for nulls, empties, and appropriate field lengths, and populates the Errors object with validation errors if found.
